sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 254 (all 276 campsites parsed, six loops)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, 2-night minimum; a 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 7 days of arrival, and campsites can be booked for today. The campground has no designated walk-in sites. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away. The registered camper must be 18 with ID. Cabins need 3 nights all season.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/watkins-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=254 ('Reservations for campsites may be booked 9 months in advance for a 2-night minimum stay'; 'If you make your reservation within 7 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; 'The campground does NOT have designated walk-in sites'; LENGTH OF STAY; 'Rustic Cabins ... 3-night minimum required all season'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Only the Mohawk Village and Cayuga Village loops have electric: 97 of 276 listed campsites (49 at 30 A, 45 at 50/30 A, 3 at 50 A). No full-hookup sites.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/watkins-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=254 ('Mohawk Village and Cayuga Village are the ONLY loops with electric sites') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 254 ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 49, '50/30 amp' 45, '50 amp' 3, '- no' 179; 'Full Hookup - no' on all), read 2026-10-21

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 276 campsites in six loops: 18 back-in and 3 pull-through at 40 ft, 1 pull-through at 36 ft, 25 at 35 ft, 111 at 30 ft, 65 at 25 ft, 36 at 20 ft, 17 with no length listed. Also 9 rustic cabins.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/watkins-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=254 ('The park offers 305 campsites'; 'Campsite (276)') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 254 (Equip length/Driveway '40 Back-In' 18, '40 Pull-Through' 3, '36 Pull-Through' 1, '35 Back-In' 25, '30 Back-In' 110, '30 Pull-Through' 1, '25 Back-In' 64, '25' 1, '20 Back-In' 36, 'Back-In' 17), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/watkins-glen-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=254 ('305 campsites with restrooms, hot showers, dumping stations and firewood for sale'; Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Restroom, Showers, Water Fillup Station), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP, on the plateau above the gorge; Olympic-size pool (end of June to Labor Day). Use the South Entrance (3530 State Route 419) for camping. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season (Cayuga/Mohawk May 7, the rest May 14, to Oct 10; unchanged), reservable, 305 campsites. Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum (1 night within 7 days), 14-night max, no walk-in sites, 50 A (97 electric sites, Mohawk and Cayuga only), max 40 ft with pull-throughs, showers, dump, water fill. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of site/hookup/booking text; kept the gorge setting.
